stage_23a_scope: Governance and protocol design only; no model training, scoring, or new metric calculation.

research_freeze.feature_order_and_semantics: Exactly those in the sealed final_method.json and Stage 16 specification; no substitution, removal, addition, or reordering.
research_freeze.final_classifier: Unweighted sklearn HistGradientBoostingClassifier with the exact sealed Stage 17B configuration.
research_freeze.selection_status: No representation, model-family, hyperparameter, loss, aggregation, or threshold selection remains.
research_freeze.confirmation_role: Independent support already obtained at Stage 17C; it is excluded from final fitting to preserve that evidential role.
research_freeze.final_test_role: One final application of the frozen final pipeline, subject to the historical-access disclosure in this protocol.

execution_order: Verify a clean repository and exact hashes for this protocol, final_method.json, governance manifest, split manifest, Stage 16 specification, Stage 17B configuration/model/decision, and preprocessing scaler.
Verify DEV_TRAIN, DEV_VAL, CONFIRMATION, and FINAL_TEST membership against the sealed manifest without loading FINAL_TEST features or labels.
Build the final-training customer representation from DEV_TRAIN plus DEV_VAL only, preserving all sealed preprocessing, usable-window, feature-order, and customer-exclusion rules.
Recompute only the four label-free Stage 16 training-reference q90 values from all usable DEV_TRAIN plus DEV_VAL windows and freeze them before opening FINAL_TEST.
Fit exactly one unweighted HGB model with the sealed parameters to the 29,655 representation-available final-training customers.
Write and hash the fitted model and final-training references; verify the fixed threshold value is unchanged.
Only after all preceding steps pass, load FINAL_TEST features and labels once, construct the exact representation using frozen final-training references, and score each eligible customer once.
Compute the pre-specified descriptive, primary, secondary, and bootstrap outputs once without adaptation.
Write the immutable predictions, metrics, uncertainty, execution audit, and report; perform artifact assertions and disclose historical FINAL_TEST access.

training_reference_recomputation.reason: Stage 16 persistence summaries are defined relative to training-window distributions and therefore must be recomputed after the pre-specified expansion from DEV_TRAIN to DEV_TRAIN plus DEV_VAL.
training_reference_recomputation.population: All usable stride-30 windows from DEV_TRAIN plus DEV_VAL only.

threshold.source: Stage 17B DEV_VAL positive-class maximum-F1 operating point
threshold.interpretive_limit: The combined-development refit can change probability calibration; threshold metrics are secondary and must be reported with this transfer limitation.

uncertainty.single_class_policy: Discard deterministically and continue until 2,000 valid replicates; report attempts and discards.

historical_final_test_access.accessed_pipeline: Historical balanced window-level supervised HGB with customer aggregation
historical_final_test_access.influence_on_final_full_48_hgb: The Stage 13 FINAL_TEST result was not used in Stages 14-22 to select the direct-customer FULL_48 representation, Stage 17B HGB configuration, or fixed threshold.
historical_final_test_access.required_paper_terminology: final evaluation cohort with disclosed historical baseline access
historical_final_test_access.required_reporting: Report the Stage 13 result separately as historical exploratory window-baseline evidence and Stage 23B as the single frozen final-pipeline evaluation; do not present the cohort as pristine, untouched, or never seen.

prohibited_actions: Use CONFIRMATION in final fitting, reference computation, calibration, thresholding, or Stage 23B reporting calculations.
Inspect FINAL_TEST features, labels, predictions, subgroup results, or metrics before the final model and training references are sealed.
Change preprocessing, usable-window criteria, feature definitions, feature order, representation, model family, hyperparameters, sample weights, threshold, metric set, or uncertainty method.

Refit more than once or rerun after observing FINAL_TEST outcomes, except to reproduce byte-identical outputs after a documented infrastructure-only failure that occurred before any outcome was viewed.
Perform subgroup exploration, threshold tuning, calibration, ensembling, error-driven feature work, or model comparison on FINAL_TEST.
Suppress, replace, or selectively report any pre-specified metric.
abort_conditions: Repository is dirty before execution or the Stage 23A protocol commit cannot be identified.
Any sealed artifact hash or ordered feature schema does not match.
Split membership overlaps, counts are incompatible with the sealed manifests, or protected roles cannot be isolated exactly.
Final-training eligible customer count is not 29,655 or the single established unusable original-train customer cannot be accounted for.
The implementation requires a methodological choice not explicitly fixed by final_method.json and this protocol.
The HGB implementation cannot accept the exact sealed configuration or produces a non-finite training prediction/probability.
The final model or training-reference artifacts are not written and hashed before FINAL_TEST is opened.
FINAL_TEST eligible customer or theft counts differ from 6,356 or 542 without a fully resolved, protocol-compatible explanation established before metric interpretation.
Any FINAL_TEST customer is duplicated, omitted contrary to the established usable-window rule, or receives more than one final prediction.
Any adaptive action is proposed after FINAL_TEST outcomes become visible.
